description: Restructure main page flow: AI config check first, then event name input, then detection with live mode toggle at bottom. Make dashboard link more visible. Person count prominent at top.
steps: 1. Modify src/app/page.tsx - Restructure into steps: Step 1 checks AI config (if not configured, show message + link to /settings), Step 2 shows event name input only (no mode selection), Step 3 shows detection view with person count at top and mode toggle at bottom
2. Modify src/app/page.tsx - Move mode selection toggle to BOTTOM of detection view as two buttons (Contador/Snapshot), default to 'contador'
3. Modify src/app/page.tsx - Make dashboard link more prominent/visible
4. Modify src/components/FaceDetector.tsx - In snapshot mode: capture image + show poem. In contador mode: only counting, no snapshot capture. Ensure mode switching works live.
acceptance_criteria: If AI is not configured, user sees a message directing them to /settings before proceeding
If AI is configured, user goes directly to event name input (no mode selection at this step)
After entering event name, detection starts immediately in 'contador' mode by default
Mode toggle (Contador/Snapshot) is at the BOTTOM of the detection screen and can be switched live
Person count is prominently displayed at the top of the detection view
Dashboard link is clearly visible and accessible
The camera icon capture counter is separate from the person count
npm run build completes without errors
verification: Run: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/emociones-app && npm run build
findings: Build passes cleanly. Added aiConfigChecked state to prevent flash of unconfigured state. Dashboard link text always visible (removed hidden sm:inline). Mode toggle at bottom with live switching and snapshot tracking reset.
